Direct EC degree-2 polynomial formula

1. Transform raw predictors:
   z1 = pH_CaCl2
   z2 = pH_H2O
   z3 = log(1 + OC)
   z4 = log(1 + P)
   z5 = log(1 + N)
   z6 = log(1 + K)
   z7 = log(1 + Coarse)
   z8 = log(1 + Clay)
   z9 = Sand
   z10 = Silt

2. Standardize predictors:
   x1 = (z1 - 5.75029096736105) / 1.35284106184363
   x2 = (z2 - 6.28206122965336) / 1.28175063286394
   x3 = (z3 - 3.23515060231796) / 0.858520056041163
   x4 = (z4 - 3.36172250036915) / 0.629765598624263
   x5 = (z5 - 1.20973259302886) / 0.50047159310157
   x6 = (z6 - 5.06180682186485) / 0.809495084547534
   x7 = (z7 - 2.49036801340431) / 0.758730265027146
   x8 = (z8 - 2.77738938989812) / 0.732946521771966
   x9 = (z9 - 41.4067639369149) / 25.1747622694817
   x10 = (z10 - 39.2314244749937) / 17.9697249031209

3. Compute u_hat = log(1 + EC_sat_hat):
   u_hat = 0.81410191846924 + 0.906779893804107*(x1) - 0.749013106756177*(x2) - 0.145569343269351*(x3) + 0.0245759218065661*(x4) + 0.304741924810321*(x5) + 0.077204262090433*(x6) - 0.0141710511974165*(x7) - 0.0383043665084828*(x8) + 0.0174706316457712*(x9) + 0.0257943815582622*(x10) + 0.239001370290433*(x1^2) + 0.251369795897419*(x2^2) + 0.057929984550983*(x3^2) + 0.000836765252099434*(x4^2) + 0.0489117310818559*(x5^2) + 0.0245257240632358*(x6^2) - 0.00401751324253351*(x7^2) + 0.0669818110256799*(x8^2) + 0.0889355985181137*(x9^2) + 0.00955779555488021*(x10^2) - 0.34035486955602*(x1*x2) - 0.115917859438204*(x1*x3) - 0.0433062070095353*(x1*x4) + 0.271736809846778*(x1*x5) + 0.195528941798106*(x1*x6) + 0.0144898413354143*(x1*x7) - 0.316112688215189*(x1*x8) - 0.177236444296171*(x1*x9) - 0.00322024079755524*(x1*x10) + 0.246679908475362*(x2*x3) + 0.0451418653620044*(x2*x4) - 0.364678920218184*(x2*x5) - 0.235452163680933*(x2*x6) - 0.0113214221225918*(x2*x7) + 0.247095488790471*(x2*x8) + 0.0989586827166322*(x2*x9) - 0.0343619778325254*(x2*x10) - 0.0304327890741196*(x3*x4) - 0.107876859626242*(x3*x5) + 0.00655718742447649*(x3*x6) - 0.00830841416749546*(x3*x7) - 0.099736520924429*(x3*x8) - 0.0971515112372501*(x3*x9) - 0.043650222371563*(x3*x10) + 0.0445412533676885*(x4*x5) + 0.011570973634806*(x4*x6) + 0.00311206278499647*(x4*x7) + 0.0069848190524224*(x4*x8) + 0.0346966631493882*(x4*x9) + 0.00951735375330701*(x4*x10) - 0.0434540684264805*(x5*x6) + 0.00838846160779429*(x5*x7) + 0.127152754884929*(x5*x8) + 0.150408401473913*(x5*x9) + 0.0817894348066069*(x5*x10) - 0.0080431007472921*(x6*x7) - 0.046068738432271*(x6*x8) - 0.0360699796685349*(x6*x9) - 0.00201764357383206*(x6*x10) - 0.00158634830330345*(x7*x8) - 0.0160409958779833*(x7*x9) - 0.0161867111145927*(x7*x10) + 0.133344108007085*(x8*x9) + 0.0526621327752714*(x8*x10) + 0.0871021344872516*(x9*x10)

4. Back-transform:
   EC_sat_hat = exp(u_hat) - 1
